_doc: Rows of fig_maze_conditions, top to bottom. One entry = one row. To add a row: append an entry with status 'landed', its BARS artefact and schema ('w16' = rows.nway[arm].per_seed; 'w19' = rows.nway.per_seed[arm]). No code change. Labels are the Head's rule (PREREG-w21-words-full-test.md, THE LABEL RULE), applied by one function to every symmetric row; an asymmetric row is labelled ASYMMETRIC and gets no claim label. Where the artefact carries HEAD_LABEL the build asserts equality.

rows.label: Rivals on the observation
rows.note: ASYMMETRIC: rivals read a 636-dim observation, the CLU the 318-wide word design
